newsitem.title: USA: Piedmont cutting N. Carolina rates further.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont cutting N. Carolina rates further.

text.p: Piedmont Natural Gas Co said Monday it was cutting rates to its North Carolina residential customers by an additional 5.0 percent, effecrtive April 1.
The reduction follows a 16 percent cut that went into effect March 1, the company said.

In both reductions, Piedmont said it was passing on to its residential customers a reduction in wholesale price of gas that it received from its suppliers. The lower wholesale price was due to mild weather over the past two months.
